meta.tagline: Restaurant & café jobs with clear terms
meta.description: Hire verified kitchen and service staff, or find restaurant and café jobs with salary, shift and weekly offs shown upfront.

footer.note: Basic access is free for workers.

common.errorHint: Please try again. If it keeps happening, tell our team.

home.heroTitle: Restaurant and café jobs, with the real terms shown upfront
home.heroSubtitle: Owners find skilled chefs, waiters and baristas. Workers see salary, shift timing, weekly offs, meals and stay before applying.
home.point1Text: Every job shows salary, shift timing, weekly offs, meals, accommodation and deductions. No surprises after joining.
home.point2Text: Jobs found here and confirmed by both sides are marked Verified. Everything else is clearly marked Self-reported.
home.point3Text: Search by role, cuisine and skill: tandoor, wok, pastry, barista, table service and more.
